contracts.protection_obligation: scout_agent's fetch_web_page invocations must be validated by the domain_safety_guard before execution: the url argument must be present, use an http/https scheme, and its netloc must not contain a policies.yaml blocked keyword or end with a blocked TLD; otherwise the fetch is blocked before the outbound HTTP request executes.
scope_limits: Only scout_agent registers fetch_web_page (agent.py:110), so this branch is reachable only via scout_agent tool calls.

For URLs containing 'mock-competitor.com', mcp_server.fetch_web_page returns canned content without performing the HTTP request (mcp_server.py:30-35), so the guarded commit point is not reached on that path.

Domain blocklist uses substring matching against the lowercased netloc and TLD blocklist uses suffix matching (safety.py:149-167); the scheme check is exact membership in (http, https) after urlparse (safety.py:140-147).
The guard inspects only the caller-supplied url argument; the client is configured with follow_redirects=True (mcp_server.py:37), so redirect targets are not re-validated by this guard.
Blacklist contents are the static entries in policies.yaml:30-52 (10 domains, 10 TLDs); no domain allowlist exists.

contracts.protection_obligation: Every tool invocation by scout_agent, analyst_agent, db_analyst_agent, and coordinator_agent must pass through the registered before_tool_callback (domain_safety_guard), which enforces the policies.yaml per-role tool allowlists and blocks execution of any tool not allowed for the invoking agent's role before the tool executes.
scope_limits: transfer_to_agent is always allowed regardless of role (safety.py:52-54) and additionally appears in every role allowlist (policies.yaml:7-28).
Authorization is exact tool-name matching against static policies.yaml allowlists; the local environment's blocked_tools list (policies.yaml:3-5) is empty and is not referenced by app/safety.py.

The callback also resolves bracketed [[VARIABLE]] placeholders in tool arguments from session state/environment before execution (safety.py:129-132); argument-level blocking exists only for the fetch_web_page branch (covered by a separate contract).

agent_name falls back to 'root_agent' when tool_context.agent_name is falsy (safety.py:120); 'root_agent' has no role entry in policies.yaml, so under that fallback every tool except transfer_to_agent would be blocked.
